title: feat(studio): a dashboard list's New opens the app's design mode on its dashboards
body:
Fixes #36907

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在 Studio 的仪表盘列表点「新建」，会直接打开对应应用，「设计布局」已开、「添加菜单项」停在仪表盘一栏；建好的仪表盘挂在菜单上并进入编辑，点 × 回到 Studio 列表；手机宽度不出现「新建」，包里没有可打开的应用时也不出现，并写明原因。
- 属于「Studio 重构」专题，落实你定的「新建跳到设计模式加菜单」，让新仪表盘不会游离在所有菜单之外。
- 出错时管理员在 Studio 里可能新建不了仪表盘，或进不了设计模式；已有仪表盘、报表和菜单不受影响，纯前端改动，可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

The Studio dashboard list's New now uses design mode's existing 「Add menu item → New dashboard…」 flow (#36364), the maintainer's 「新建跳到设计模式加菜单」 (dashboard half). The report half (decision 13) is unchanged.

**The arrival (`layout/designModeArrival.ts`, `layout/useDesignModeArrival.ts`).** A second navigation-state arrival, `designModeAddDashboard`, sits beside `designModeNewDashboard` and carries the Studio list it came from. `ConsoleLayout` reads it once per history entry through `useDesignModeArrival`. It first replaces the entry without the arrival, so a reload or Back enters nothing. Then it asks the mode to `enterOpening({ column: 'dashboard', studioReturn })`.
- ⛔ No URL enters design mode. The arrival rides navigation state only; the landing address carries no `?studio=` and no mode.
- `enterOpening` is `enter` plus a one-shot "opening" held in the mode store. Where `enter` refuses (an editor holds the mode out, PR #36848), nothing is held and the mode's own `designMode.editorOpen` toast says why. On a phone the arrival is cleared and nothing more happens.
- The held-out count moved from state to a ref. An editor that opens in the same commit the arrival lands in is then still judged (pinned; ablation A5c below). `enter()` keeps its zero-argument contract: a click event is never an opening.

**`DesignModeMenu`** takes the opening once (`useDesignModeOpening`). It opens the picker on 「Dashboards」 for an entry at the end of the top level, as that level's 「Add menu item」 would. A dashboard created from that picker navigates with `withStudioReturn(href, studioReturn)`, so the dashboard page's existing × goes back to the Studio list (`?studio=`). Closing that picker drops the return, and later adds are plain.

**Studio (`StudioAreaAppOpen.tsx`, `studioAppEdit.ts`, `StudioMetadataArea.tsx`).** `StudioAreaAppTarget` gains `{ kind: 'new-dashboard' }`. `AreaCreate` sends `dashboard/new` through it, under the same condition the report leg uses (`!readOnly || pairCreate`). It replaces the Studio address with `/apps/SEGMENT` (`appHomePath`) and the arrival.
- The app comes from decision 6 via `studioAppCreateSegment`.
- The `.custom` pair leg from #37348 applies: a pair with no app of its own reads its base's apps. That reading is factored into `readStudioTargetApps`, which the item leg now shares too.
- With no app, or on a phone, the fallback is the area's own create, as for a report.

**The list (`ResourceListPage.tsx`).** `useStudioDashboardNew` gates the area's dashboard 新建 by the same reads. It never shows at phone width, and it is not drawn while the apps are being read. With no target app the header shows no 新建 and shows a `role="note"` reason instead (`engine.list.dashboardNewNoApp`); the empty state says the same.

**Riders from seat 4's L1 on PR #37348.**
- N1: the `StudioAreaAppOpen-36906` test header now says a pair row opens in the base's app.
- N2: this changeset carries a note on the #37237 entry: rule 1's menu leg (the remembered app counts when its menu opens the item) applies on the pair leg too.

Additive en and zh keys: `engine.list.dashboardNewNoApp` and `engine.list.dashboardNewWiderScreen` (the phone empty state, from the L1 S1 round) in the `studio` namespace (it is en/zh only). No server, spec or route change.

## Read first

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/useDesignModeArrival.ts`: the consume-then-enter order. Risk: it navigates (replace) in the same commit `AppRootLanding`'s redirect may navigate. Child effects run first, so the landing redirect re-applies on the next render; see Acceptance notes.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designMode.tsx`: `enterWith` / `enterOpening` / `takeOpening`, and `heldOut` moving to a ref.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioAreaAppOpen.tsx`: the `new-dashboard` leg and `useStudioDashboardNew`.

## Tests

| A created dashboard is in the menu and opens for editing, × back to the list | `DesignModeMenu-36363` | A3 `withStudioReturn` dropped → 1 red |
| CONTROL: the report 新建 is unchanged | existing 36906 report-New tests and pair report-New control; list control `CONTROL — the report list` | (control: green under every ablation) |
| No 新建 at phone width | `ResourceListPage.pairCreate-36897` (`dashboard list's 「新建」…`) | A8 phone read as false → 1 red |

| A refused `enter()` does nothing | `DesignModeMenu-36363` | A5 hold ignored → 2 red; A5c render-time snapshot of the hold → the same-commit pin red, the prior-editor pin green |
| The pair leg | `StudioAreaAppOpen-36906`, `ResourceListPage.pairCreate-36897` | A7 pair leg off (Studio) → 2 red; A7b (list) → 1 red |
| The arrival is consumed (reload / Back enter nothing) | `DesignModeMenu-36363` | A4 replace removed → 4 red |

Moved by this change, and re-pinned rather than deleted:
- 36906's "a dashboard New is not this card" half is now the new describe.
- 36906's "a dashboard made by the area's create … Back lands on the list" runs at phone width, the one place the area's own dashboard create is still reached from a list.

## Acceptance notes

- **Double replace at the app root.** `useDesignModeArrival` replaces the history entry it read, in the same commit `AppRootLanding` may redirect to the app's landing. Child effects run first, so the landing redirect re-applies on the next render. In the browser, the showcase landed on its first page (`/page/showcase_capability_map`) with the mode on and `history.state.usr === null`. A self-built app whose menu holds only links stays on `/apps/ID`, with the same result.
- **An app whose menu is split into `areas`** keeps its plain menu under design mode, because `UnifiedSidebar` draws the editor only when `areas.length === 0`. That predates this PR. There the arrival enters the mode but no picker opens. No example app uses `areas`. See the report's open question.
- **The arrival does not repeat the 「Design layout」 door's own gate** (`useStudioEntryGate` and the customization wall). The Studio list's 新建 is already gated by `canCreate` (`walled`, `pairCreate`), and the server judges every write again.
- **The held-out count moved from state to a ref** (`designMode.tsx`). Nothing rendered from it; `enter` is the only reader. The existing 36692 pins pass unchanged.
- **The pair leg is applied to the dashboard New only.** A pair's report New still falls back to the area's own create, pinned as CONTROL per the dispatch's "report 新建 unchanged". Whether it should gain the leg is in the report's open questions.
- While the package's apps are being read, the list draws no 新建, so a no-app package never flashes one.

## Verification

- Browser walk on the showcase stack: `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38461` (seeded admin), and the Console from `ui/` sources via `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console dev` on :5180 pointed at it. Driven with Playwright from a scratch script, not committed.
  - **Showcase** (`com.example.showcase`, a read-only code package; the HotCRM shape): Studio › dashboard list › 新建 lands on `/apps/com.example.showcase/page/showcase_capability_map` with the Design layout bar and the 「Add menu item」 picker on Dashboards (「New dashboard…」 first). The history entry's state was cleared.
    - Create lands on `/apps/com.example.showcase/dashboard/walk_showcase?studio=/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/dashboard?package=com.example.showcase` in its edit state, with the × drawn. The entry is in the menu, and the dashboard was saved to `com.example.showcase.custom`.
    - A reload of that page shows no design bar. × returns to the Studio list.
  - **Self-built** (`com.walk.selfbuilt`, created through `POST /api/v1/packages` with one app `walk_app`): 新建 lands on `/apps/com.walk.selfbuilt` with the bar and picker. Create opens `/apps/com.walk.selfbuilt/dashboard/walk_selfbuilt?studio=…`, and the dashboard was saved to `com.walk.selfbuilt`. × returns to the list.
  - **No app** (`com.walk.noapp`): no 新建, and the note reads "A new dashboard is made in an app's design mode, so that it hangs in a menu. This package has no app to make it in."
  - **Phone** (390 px): no 新建 and no note.
- Two-minute check: in Studio, open any package's Dashboards list and press 新建. Expect the app with the purple Design layout bar and the 「Add menu item」 dialog already on Dashboards.
